quotes.text: We have a lot of internal inconsistencies with different tables… I'm trying to build in these kind of manual checks and balances

listenFor: "The tables don't agree with each other."
"Someone has to read everything before it goes out."
patterns.discovery: When the document is nearly final, what does your team still verify by hand across the tables, the narrative, and the schedules?
patterns.talkTrack: You said you're building manual checks for inconsistencies between tables. That's a first pass Workiva AI can take inside the document, with your team confirming anything it flags.

quotes.text: Wait, you do GAAP to stat? Tell me more… I'm over here manually doing this

listenFor: "We reconcile GAAP to stat by hand."
"We explain the same differences every year."
patterns.discovery: When you reconcile GAAP to statutory, how much of the time is the math, and how much is explaining and documenting the differences?
patterns.talkTrack: You mentioned doing GAAP-to-stat manually. Once the numbers are in Workiva, the explanation of each difference is something Workiva AI can draft from the reconciliation for your team to verify.
